message.text:
Checking whether GetLinkMetadata or similar RPCs fetch user-provided URLs. The term "user-configured URL" might refer to webhooks or metadata endpoints.

Webhooks are the likely source of outbound user-configured URLs. Three RPC handlers converge on `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` or `webhook.PostAsync` or `webhook.Post`. Comment creation bypasses `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` and routes directly to `PostAsync`.

`webhook.PostAsync` is the single function where all paths converge before delivery. `CreateMemo`, `UpdateMemo`, and `DeleteMemo` in `memo_service.go` are the three RPC handlers.

Additional RPC handlers were found: `SetMemoAttachments` in `memo_attachment_service.go`, `SetMemoRelations` in `memo_relation_service.go`, and `CreateMemoComment` in `memo_service_comments.go`. This exceeds the required three. The next step is verifying the exact function signatures around these line numbers.

Identifying RPC handlers that transitively trigger outbound HTTP requests to user-configured webhook URLs. Initial candidates include CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations.

CreateMemoComment also triggers webhooks by calling CreateMemo. All paths converge on `webhook.PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` before actual delivery. `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` is not the single convergence point because CreateMemoComment calls `PostAsync` directly.

GetLinkMetadata, CreateUserWebhook, UpdateUserWebhook, and SignIn with SSO were considered but do not qualify. ValidateURL performs DNS checks without outbound HTTP, and SSO identity provider calls are admin-configured rather than user-configured webhook URLs.
The six RPC handlers are CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, and CreateMemoComment. They all transitively reach PostAsync in internal/webhook/webhook.go.

h06.
CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, CreateMemoComment; PostAsync — internal/webhook/webhook.go

Those RPC handlers dispatch memo webhooks (create/update/delete/comment). Create/update/delete go through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`; comment created calls `PostAsync` directly. Every path enqueues on `webhook.PostAsync` before `Post` sends the HTTP request to the user-configured webhook URL.
